newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: ANZ Grindlays arranges $30 million for Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: ANZ Grindlays arranges $30 million for Pakistan.

text.p: The ANZ Grindlays Bank Ltd said on Monday it has arranged and underwritten a $30 million revolving letter of credit and financing facility for the state-run Pakistan State Oil.
In a statement the Melbourne-based bank's Karachi branch said the facility will be used by PSO for oil imports.
PSO commands 76 percent of Pakistan's oil products distribution market, which is worth an estimated 100 billion rupees a year.
ANZ said the credit was the latest of similar facilities arranged by the bank for state-owned companies and on behalf of the government of Pakistan.
